facts.business: SBEC Sugar Limited is engaged in the manufacturing of sugar and related by-products, and through its subsidiaries, in bioenergy and stockholding & investment activities.

guidance_or_targets.statement: Revenue from operations projected at Rs 71,406 lacs for FY 2026-27, Rs 76,617 lacs for FY 2027-28, Rs 77,559 lacs for FY 2028-29, Rs 78,248 lacs for FY 2029-30, and Rs 85,517 lacs for FY 2030-31.
EBIDTA projected at Rs 6,710 lacs for FY 2026-27, Rs 6,473 lacs for FY 2027-28, Rs 9,029 lacs for FY 2028-29, Rs 9,452 lacs for FY 2029-30, and Rs 12,406 lacs for FY 2030-31.
Net Profit projected at Rs 1,232 lacs for FY 2026-27, Rs 1,555 lacs for FY 2027-28, Rs 4,655 lacs for FY 2028-29, Rs 5,520 lacs for FY 2029-30, and Rs 8,856 lacs for FY 2030-31.

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in the provided excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Qualified Opinion: Non-provision of interest on late payment of cane dues amounting to Rs 2,642.76 lacs for sugar season 2024-25 and Rs 901.02 lacs for sugar season 2025-26, which would have increased the loss by Rs 3,543.78 lacs. Emphasis of Matters: (i) Non-provision of interest on cane dues for sugar seasons 2012-13, 2013-14, and 2014-15 pending court orders and Cane Commissioner's decision. (ii) Settlement of Debt Assignment Recoverable of Rs 14,685.98 lacs with Modi Industries Limited for Rs 14,177.39 lacs, resulting in a settlement loss of Rs 508.59 lacs included in Other Expenses.

key_risks: Non-provision of interest on late payment of cane dues for multiple sugar seasons, leading to qualification in audit report and potential higher losses.
Pending litigation regarding waiver of interest on cane dues for sugar seasons 2012-13, 2013-14, and 2014-15 before the Cane Commissioner and courts.
High finance costs (Rs 4,162.82 lacs standalone in FY 2026) and significant borrowings (Total borrowings Rs 27,340.56 lacs as on 31.03.2026).
Settlement loss on debt assignment recoverable from related party Modi Industries Limited.
Accumulated losses leading to negative retained earnings (debit balance of Rs 31,772.32 lacs as on 31.03.2026).
facts.related_party_note: The company settled Debt Assignment Recoverable of Rs 14,685.98 lacs with Modi Industries Limited for Rs 14,177.39 lacs as on 31st Dec 2025, resulting in a settlement loss of Rs 508.59 lacs included in Other Expenses. The company received Rs 5,950.00 lacs till March 2026 and subsequently Rs 8,227.39 lacs aggregating to Rs 14,177.39 lacs along with interest of Rs 233.54 lacs till the date of actual receipt. Personal guarantees given by Mr. Umesh Modi and Mr. Abhishek Modi for SVC Co-operative Bank loan. Corporate guarantee given by SBEC Bioenergy Limited for the same loan.
